implementation.targetScope: React19 swipe hook: touch/mouse gestures, direction/threshold/rotation/duration, callbacks, passive scrolling and listener lifecycle. Verified configurator/messenger callback contracts; application adoption separate.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies besides the React19 peer; no upstream runtime copied.
Touch cancellation, additional or changed fingers, replaced/unmounted targets, disabled mouse tracking and window blur invalidate pending gestures.
Mouse tracking belongs to the target document; callback data mutations cannot corrupt internal state.
Expired gestures are not taps; callbacks are refreshed after React commits; stable handlers avoid listener churn.

caller.contract: Two direction-gated close callbacks; default touch/passive scrolling; no mouse override; refs forwarded through Dialog or HStack. Browser fixture models this contract, not complete authenticated components.
